1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 g6 3.Bf4 Bg7 4.e3 d6 5.h3.strategy: Develops the bishop and prepares castling while the queen, the knight and the e-pawn hold d4 comfortably. White keeps the structure solid and leaves Black to decide how to resolve the tension in the centre.
